title: Story card
description: A vertical 9:16 story or ad, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} Alert, Avatar, Badge, Button, Card and Skeleton primitives: the brand's Avatar and name with a Sponsored Badge, an optional image, a kicker, a serif title, a short detail and one full-width action Button, with its own loading, empty and error renders; responds to its container (@container) — the title and detail step up at @sm, the card reaches its full size with more room inside at @md, and it gets room above and below at @lg.
